legend: The pandemic is upon us, and the world is in shortage of the most important resource: toilet paper. As one of the best prepared nations for this crisis, BubbleLand promised to help all other world nations with this valuable resource. To do that, the country will send airplanes to other countries carrying toilet paper.

In BubbleLand, there are N$$$N$$$ toilet paper factories, and N$$$N$$$ airports. Because of how much it takes to build a road, and of course legal issues, every factory must send paper to only one airport, and every airport can only take toilet paper from one factory.
Also, a road can't be built between all airport-factory pairs, again because of legal issues. Every possible road has number d$$$d$$$ given, number of days it takes to build that road.
Your job is to choose N$$$N$$$ factory-airport pairs, such that if the country starts building all roads at the same time, it takes the least amount of days to complete them.
input: The first line contains two integers N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤104)$$$(1 \leq N \leq 10^4)$$$ - number of airports/factories, and M$$$M$$$ (1≤M≤105)$$$(1 \leq M \leq 10^5)$$$ - number of available pairs to build a road between.

On next M$$$M$$$ lines, there are three integers u$$$u$$$, v$$$v$$$ (1≤u,v≤N)$$$(1 \leq u,v \leq N)$$$, d$$$d$$$ (1≤d≤109)$$$(1 \leq d \leq 10^9)$$$ - meaning that you can build a road between airport u$$$u$$$ and factory v$$$v$$$ for d$$$d$$$ days.
output: If there are no solutions, output -1. If there exists a solution, output the minimal number of days to complete all roads, equal to maximal d$$$d$$$ among all chosen roads.

legend.ai: 疫情已经来临，世界正面临最重要资源的短缺：卫生纸。作为在这场危机中准备最充分的国家之一，泡泡国承诺向世界其他国家提供这种宝贵的资源。为此，该国将派出飞机，把卫生纸运往其他国家。
在泡泡国，有 N$$$N$$$ 家卫生纸厂和 N$$$N$$$ 个机场。由于修建道路的代价高昂，当然还有法律问题，每家工厂只能把纸送往一个机场，每个机场也只能从一家工厂接收卫生纸。
此外，并非所有机场-工厂对之间都能修建道路，同样是因为法律问题。每条可修建的道路都有一个给定的数字 d$$$d$$$，表示修建该道路所需的天数。
你的任务是选择 N$$$N$$$ 个工厂-机场对，使得如果该国同时开始修建所有这些道路，完成它们所需的天数最少。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤104)$$$(1 \leq N \leq 10^4)$$$——机场/工厂的数量，以及 M$$$M$$$ (1≤M≤105)$$$(1 \leq M \leq 10^5)$$$——可修建道路的可用对数。
接下来的 M$$$M$$$ 行中，每行包含三个整数 u$$$u$$$、v$$$v$$$(1≤u,v≤N)$$$(1 \leq u,v \leq N)$$$ 和 d$$$d$$$(1≤d≤109)$$$(1 \leq d \leq 10^9)$$$，表示你可以在机场 u$$$u$$$ 与工厂 v$$$v$$$ 之间修建一条需要 d$$$d$$$ 天的道路。

output.ai: 如果不存在解，输出 -1。如果存在解，输出完成所有道路所需的最少天数，即所有选中道路中 d$$$d$$$ 的最大值。
